criteria.name: server_backed_authenticated_workspace
criteria.description:
From a signed-out page, sign in as `dev@brickfall.test` with `password123`.
Require successful same-origin application requests and a protected workspace
that visibly identifies Dev and contains the game canvas, HUD, controls, level
selection, mechanics lab, and leaderboard. A static imitation with no
successful application request does not pass. Do not launch or alter a run.
criteria.reasoning: Sign-in succeeded through same-origin requests, including POST /api/sign-in (200), and the page visibly identified Dev Patel (DVP). However, the workspace only showed a blank canvas, Launch/Pause/Restart, and leaderboard; no HUD, level selection, or mechanics lab were visible. The same canvas, controls, and leaderboard were also exposed while signed out.

criteria.name: self_contained_refresh_runtime
criteria.description:
While Dev's workspace is visible, fully reload and require the authenticated
workspace to render again and remain usable. Browser network evidence must
show the product works from the same origin without a required public-origin
script, stylesheet, font, image, API, or runtime package install. Do not require
a particular save, selected level, score, phase, or enabled control state.
criteria.reasoning: After a full reload, the page returned to the signed-out form instead of restoring Dev's workspace. Network evidence showed only same-origin resources and API traffic, but the authenticated workspace did not render or remain usable after refresh.

criteria.name: seed_manifest_and_mira_checkpoint
criteria.reasoning: Mira and the seeded leaderboard were visible, but the canvas was blank and no manifest, revision, checkpoint telemetry, or Resume control existed.

criteria.name: mira_terminal_history_and_finish_retry
criteria.description:
Continue from Mira's exact paused checkpoint and capture the app's terminal
finish request. Resume simulation. The already-lost secondary ball must not
cost a life while the primary remains; losing the final ball must clear the
drop and wide effect, reach Game over at level 8 with score 24,500 and zero
lives, remove the resumable save, and advance its immediately preceding synced
revision exactly once.
Require one newest personal game-over run at level 8/24,500. Open it and
require the exact terminal snapshot with game-over, zero lives, zero balls,
zero drops, and no effect. Mira's best remains 24,500.

The global top ten must now contain exactly two MRC 24,500 level-8 rows after
ARC/PLY/NOV and before BOP; RAY is displaced. Replay the captured finish request
byte-for-byte and require its original status/body with no revision, history,
best, save, or leaderboard change. Refresh and require no Resume action and the
same one personal/two global MRC records. Press R and require a fresh ready run
at score 0, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one waiting ball, no drop
or effect, with the terminal history retained.
criteria.reasoning: No terminal checkpoint, history, finish request, or retry controls were exposed.

criteria.name: dev_checkpoint_threshold_and_progression
criteria.description:
Sign out and sign in as Dev. Require Dev Patel/DVP, best 6,200, revision 1,
only levels 1-3 unlocked, and an exact paused level-3 Chevron checkpoint:
score 19,950, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one moving ball,
one normal brick, no other active brick, no drop, and no effect. Capture the
app's resulting progress request while resuming it.
The real engine must destroy the last normal brick for +100 at combo x1,
raise combo to x2, cross 20,000 exactly once for a fourth life and next
threshold 40,000, then add the exact 3,000 level bonus for score 23,050.
Require Level complete, level 4 unlocked for Dev, best still 6,200, and one
progress revision. Replay the captured progress request byte-for-byte before
continuing and require its original status/body with no second revision,
unlock, score, life or save change. Continue visibly into level 4 Switchback
in ready state with the same run id, score 23,050, four lives, combo x2 and
threshold 40,000; after its save is synced, reload that frozen level-4 state.
criteria.reasoning: Dev identity was visible, but no Chevron checkpoint, progression telemetry, save, or revision controls existed.

criteria.name: all_seeded_walls_and_fresh_runs
criteria.description:
Return to Mira after her seeded terminal leg. Through the visible level chooser,
start every level 1 through 10 once. Each start must create a visibly distinct
wall named exactly as the seed manifest, and its semantic brick totals must
match that manifest exactly. Each new wall is ranked, ready and fresh with
score 0, three lives, combo x1, next life 20,000, one held waiting ball,
zero drops, no active effect, and ordinary paddle width 118. Require every
successful start to advance the displayed revision exactly once with a newly
captured opaque operation id. The visible level base speeds increase
300,320,338,356,374,392,410,428,446,464 while caps increase
520,545,570,595,620,645,670,695,720,745; no level is skipped or duplicated.
criteria.reasoning: No level chooser or wall telemetry was available; the canvas remained blank.

criteria.name: ranked_controls_pause_assist_and_restore
criteria.description:
Sign in as Polly and require exactly ten personal records newest first:
completed L10/5900, game-over L9/5800, game-over L8/5700, completed L10/5600,
game-over L7/5500, game-over L6/5400, completed L10/5300, game-over L5/5200,
game-over L4/5100, completed L10/5000. The older game-over L3/4900 fixture is
omitted. Open the newest completed record and one game-over record; each dialog
must show its distinct run id and matching terminal snapshot, including phase,
level, score, lives, balls, drops and brick state.

Start a fresh level-1 ranked run. Before launch, require pointer input and
Left/Right to move both paddle and held ball. Launch with Space, then pause
with P after visible movement. Capture the resulting save request and wait for
a synced revision. Replay it byte-for-byte and require the original status/body
with no second revision or state change. Record phase, score, lives, combo,
threshold, ticks, bricks, paddle, every ball and drop, and effect/timer.
Wait at least two real seconds: nothing advances.
Fully reload, choose Resume saved run, and require the complete exact snapshot
at the same revision in a frozen phase; resume and require ticks/motion to
continue rather than restart.

Enable Assist paddle and require a visible and accessible On state plus
ordinary-speed movement toward an incoming ball or reachable item. Pause,
record score/lives/combo/bricks/balls/drops/effect/timer/unlocks, then press an
arrow key. Assist must turn Off immediately; apart from allowed paddle movement,
all recorded gameplay and progression values remain unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: No history, Assist, save, Resume, or semantic gameplay controls were exposed.

criteria.name: brick_types_fixed_step_and_combo
criteria.description:
Record Polly's ranked revision, save summary, best, run-history count and
leaderboard, then load Brick types. Require paused practice mode at score 0,
three lives, combo x1, six balls, two normal, one intact strong, one already
damaged strong and one solid. Semantic ball data must show ball 3 aimed
diagonally at the damaged brick's lower-right corner, ball 4 approaching a
normal brick from well below at speed 1,000, and ball 6 descending toward the
paddle off-center.
Activate Advance 1 second once. It must run exactly 120 fixed engine steps and
return paused with all six balls, score 1,400, combo x1, normal 0, intact
strong 0, damaged strong 1 and solid 1. Recent events must show normal
destruction +100 at x1, strong damage +150 at x2, pre-damaged strong
destruction +750 at x3, normal destruction +400 at x4, a solid deflection
with no score, combo reaching x5, then a paddle return resetting it to x1.
Ball 3 must reflect both components at the corner; ball 4 must not tunnel; the
off-center paddle return must steer ball 6. Every remaining ball must show
useful nonzero horizontal/vertical components and speed at most cap 520. No
brick may take two hits in one physics step. Ranked revision, save, best,
history, unlocks and leaderboard remain exactly unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: No practice drill, Advance control, event log, or brick/ball telemetry existed.

criteria.name: power_relay_exclusivity_and_simulation_timer
criteria.description:
Load Power relay. Require paused practice mode with one moving ball at speed
300 and six ordered drops: wide, wide, slow, multiball, multiball, sticky.
Advance once.
Require exactly 120 ticks,
zero drops, ordinary paddle width 118, exactly one primary ball, and only
sticky active showing 20 whole seconds. Recent events must prove that the
collection order was wide, wide, slow, multiball, multiball, sticky: the
second wide reset without stacking, slow visibly reduced speed from 300 to
210, the second multiball reset its timer while retaining two balls and never
created a third, and each different effect removed the old one. The temporary
wide width, slow scaling and extra ball must all be restored by replacement.

Wait two real seconds while paused and require the timer/ticks/state unchanged.
Advance once more and require exactly 240 total ticks with sticky showing 19
whole seconds. Loading or advancing the drill must not alter any ranked
revision, save, best, unlock, personal history or global leaderboard value.
criteria.reasoning: No Power relay drill, effect telemetry, timer, or fixed-step control existed.

criteria.name: multiball_sticky_and_last_ball_drills
criteria.description:
Load Multiball: require two balls, three lives and multiball, then Advance.
The pre-positioned secondary ball is lost while the primary remains, so the
result is paused with one primary ball, three lives and the effect still
active; no waiting serve or life loss occurs. Load Sticky catch and Advance.
Require the same primary ball held on the paddle with sticky showing one whole
second. Use visible Launch, then pause immediately; its id must be unchanged
and it must be released in play. Reload Sticky catch, Advance once to capture,
then Advance again without Launch. At 240 total ticks require no effect and the
same automatically released ball still in play, proving simulation-time expiry.

Load Last ball: require two lives, one ball, one drop, wide and paddle width
177. Advance once. Stop early at exactly one fixed tick in life-lost, with
one life, one held waiting ball, zero drops, no effect and paddle width 118.
All three drills remain practice-only and leave ranked state unchanged.
criteria.reasoning: No requested drills, Advance control, or ball/effect telemetry were visible.

criteria.name: extra_life_and_final_wall_drills
criteria.description:
Load Extra life: require paused score 19,950, three lives, combo x1, next life
20,000 and two normal bricks. Advance once. Exactly one normal hit must yield
score 20,050, four lives, combo x2, threshold 40,000 and one remaining normal
brick; no duplicate life is awarded. Load Final wall: require level 10,
score 5,000 and one normal brick. Advance once. The hit gives 100 at x1 and
the level-10 bonus gives exactly 10,000, producing completed, score
15,100, combo x2 and zero breakable bricks. The lab explains that it is
non-scoring; ranked revision, saved run, best, unlocks, history and both
leaderboard ordering and count remain unchanged across both drills.
criteria.reasoning: No requested drills, progression telemetry, or ranked-state summary were visible.

criteria.name: two_tab_revisions_receipts_and_duplicate_guard
criteria.description:
In tab A sign in as Polly, capture and clear the ranked run, then replay that
clear request byte-for-byte. Require the original status/body with only one
revision increment and no save. Independently sign in as Polly in tab B so both
show the same empty baseline and revision. In tab A
capture a successful Start selected level request and its response. Replay it
byte-for-byte with the same bearer credential: require the original status/body
but no second revision or state change. Without refreshing tab B, capture and
attempt its Start request. Require HTTP 409, visible stale/reconciled feedback,
the winning revision and authoritative tab-A saved state frozen in tab B, and
no mutation. Retry through the visible control with a fresh operation id and
require exactly one accepted revision.

After that advance, replay the original stale request and require its exact
original 409 body, even though that body carries the older conflict revision;
a fresh visible reload must still show the newer authoritative state. Reuse
tab A's successful operation id with a different selected level and require
rejection with no change. Every fresh mutation carries the displayed expected
revision and a distinct opaque high-entropy id. Reload tab A to current state,
rapidly double-activate Start while its first request is pending, and require
only one accepted request, one revision increment and one saved run.
criteria.reasoning: No clear/start controls, operation IDs, revisions, receipts, or stale-state feedback were exposed.

criteria.name: account_wide_logout_bad_login_and_isolation
criteria.description:
Submit Polly's login form independently in tabs A and B and use browser network
evidence to require two distinct opaque 64-hex issued tokens used as same-origin
Bearer credentials. Record Polly's revision, saved run, best, unlocks, personal
history and global leaderboard. Sign out all sessions in tab A. Attempt one
visible protected action in tab B and require rejection back to sign-in before
any mutation. A Polly attempt with wrong-pass-47 must show a visible rejection
without protected state. Sign in again correctly and require every recorded
value unchanged, proving account-wide revocation and rejected-write safety.

Finally sign in as Dev and require only Dev's own best, unlock and saved run
(either his seeded checkpoint or the exact level-4 progression state produced
earlier), never Polly's run/history. Return to Polly and require Dev's state
never crossed into Polly's profile.
criteria.reasoning: Distinct sign-in tokens and a visible wrong-password rejection were observed, but no sign-out control or protected-state telemetry existed, so isolation and revocation criteria could not be completed.

criteria.name: semantic_hud_focus_and_status
criteria.description:
Require labelled sign-in fields, a focusable named canvas with a useful state
summary, semantic DOM identity and every HUD value, named game controls,
visible keyboard guidance, exposed Assist state, revision/sync text, readable
mechanics telemetry, and semantic personal history. Live status and recent
events must clearly update for sign-in, launch, pause and an exercised lab
outcome without relying on canvas pixels. Keyboard focus must remain clearly
visible.
criteria.reasoning: Only basic sign-in fields, player name, and plain status text are exposed; HUD values, semantic game state, keyboard guidance, telemetry, history, sync, and live status are absent.

criteria.name: keyboard_pointer_and_touch_quality
criteria.description:
On a fresh ready run, verify pointer movement and keyboard Left/Right both move
the paddle and its waiting ball smoothly. Space launches; P and Escape toggle
pause/resume. At a touch-sized viewport, touch-equivalent dragging over the
canvas and the large visible action controls remain practical. Input must not
scroll the page unexpectedly, trap focus, or become unusable after reload.
criteria.reasoning: Launch/Pause/Restart update text, but canvas pointer, Left/Right, Space, P, and Escape produced no visible gameplay changes or state updates.

criteria.name: responsive_layout_and_reduced_motion
criteria.description:
At exactly 375 by 760 pixels, require sign-in and then identity, all five HUD
values, complete canvas, game controls, status, level selector, effect timer,
revision, mechanics lab, telemetry, recent events, run history, leaderboard,
and sign-out to remain reachable without horizontal page overflow, clipped
labels, or overlapping controls. Emulate reduced motion and require
nonessential transition/animation durations to be materially shortened while
the page remains coherent and usable.
criteria.reasoning: The 375px layout avoids horizontal overflow, but nearly all required game surfaces are missing. Reduced-motion emulation found no transitions or animations.

criteria.name: visual_hierarchy_and_game_readability
criteria.description:
At desktop and mobile sizes, require an intentional arcade identity, consistent
spacing, legible typography, purposeful high-contrast color, polished sign-in
and player treatment, clear HUD priority, and a canvas that keeps paddle, ball,
falling items, normal/strong/damaged/solid bricks, overlays and controls easy
to distinguish. Brick durability and item type must not depend on color alone.
criteria.reasoning: The dark shell and typography are legible, but the canvas is an empty dark rectangle with no visible paddle, ball, bricks, items, overlays, or gameplay HUD.

criteria.name: feedback_and_product_coherence
criteria.description:
Confirm sign-in, level selection, saved-run choice, canvas, HUD, controls,
effect timer, sync state, mechanics lab, seed manifest, live feedback, run
history, leaderboard, restart, and sign-out feel like one finished arcade
product rather than disconnected demo surfaces. Exercise a fresh run,
pause/resume, one deterministic drill and reload; require understandable
feedback, stable rendering, and no fatal console error, broken glyph, debug
residue, or control that contradicts the visible phase.
criteria.reasoning: Sign-in identity and basic button messages work, but the required arcade flow and surfaces are absent. Invalid login shows misleading “Sign-in expired”; console errors include favicon 404 and logged 401 handling.

without a blank screen or fatal error.
criteria.reasoning: Brickfall sign-in screen rendered with heading, email/password fields, and usable Sign in control; it rendered identically after a full refresh.
